question: Does the exact bilinear attention contraction of the locked L11H3 value-source change form an executable head-interface tensor that reproduces the observed command effect on original and OOD text?

terms: L11H3 exact source term native routing direct head install
aspectual L9H1 H4 source term factorial
Task14 L11H3 current cached value source
prior_art_search.closest: Aspectual L9H1/H4 source-term work and Task14 L11H3 subject-value work provide manual bilinear-attention precedents. They do not test the dual temporal/is-was H4 program, its locked bridge/postcue sources, the same-sequence OOD bank, or equality between a c_v patch and a separately constructed all-destination head-interface delta.
prior_art_search.novelty: First exact formula-level extraction of the task-typed L11H3 value route into a directly installable 128-dimensional head tensor at every causal destination.

frozen_design.populations: Use all 128 original and all 128 fresh OOD endpoints. Temporal source is locked to bridge and is-was source to postcue; preserve every row, phase, template, cell, group, and exact command-counterfactual pairing.
frozen_design.formula: Under recipient-native normalized rotary q/k/q2/k2, construct for every destination i the head-3 tensor delta_z_i=(1-lambda_11) sum_{j in R,j<=i} ((q_i dot k_j)/128)((q2_i dot k2_j)/128)(c_v(x_donor_j)-c_v(x_recipient_j)). R is the locked per-row source region. The layer-0 cached-value branch is unchanged and therefore cancels from this delta.
frozen_design.observed_reference: Independently execute the exact L11H3 c_v native-donor patch at R and capture its complete pre-c_proj head-3 delta at every sequence position. Recompute command-gold selected-value metrics and replay the immutable localization fields to 1e-5.
frozen_design.tensor_identity: The formula tensor must reproduce the observed pre-c_proj head delta with max absolute error <=1e-4 and relative L2 error <=1e-4 separately for each population and role.
frozen_design.direct_install: In a separate native execution with no c_v patch, add only the formula tensor to the L11H3 pre-c_proj slice at every destination. Its answer logits must match the c_v-patched reference within 1e-4; its command-margin effect must have signed recovery in [.999,1.001], cosine >=.99999, direction agreement 1.0, and relative residual <=.001 on every phase and template.
frozen_design.selectivity: Direct-install cross-role/gold norm is <=.01 in every pooled phase and is-was installation changes the earlier temporal margin by <=1e-5.
frozen_design.stored_interface: Store each population x role formula tensor at the answer query for all 128 rows, its complete-tensor norm and checksum, locked source positions, and exact row identifiers. This is an explicit interface artifact, not a fitted subspace.

predictions.pred_a_authority_pairing_native_replay_c: All authorities, row pairing, locked regions, native/value-patch captures, command-gold replay, finiteness, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_exact_bilinear_formula_equals_val: Every population and role passes both registered full-tensor identity bars.
predictions.pred_c_direct_head_interface_install_rep: Every phase/template direct-install panel passes the frozen logit/effect equality bars.
predictions.pred_d_extracted_source_term_transfers_o: B/C pass for both task-typed source regions on both populations without selection or fitting.
predictions.pred_e_extracted_interface_is_task_selec: Every collateral and later-to-earlier causal-zero bar passes.

null: If A fails, the instrument is invalid. If B fails, the proposed polynomial source tensor omits a live value path or uses the wrong numerical frame. If B passes but C fails, the tensor is algebraically correct but the direct interface installation is not execution-equivalent. If D or E fails, preserve L11H3:value localization but do not call the explicit source term extracted or sufficient. Do not change R, add QK donor factors, fit a correction, or loosen identity bars after outcome.
decision: A/B/C/D/E licenses an exact, OOD-stable, directly executable L11H3 source-term interface for the two task-typed command routes. It opens exact upstream-weight translation through W_v and later H4 explicit-background extraction; it is not yet a standalone model replacement.
